name: John Bowlby
shortBio: British psychoanalyst and psychiatrist who synthesized psychoanalysis with ethology, evolutionary biology, and control theory to create Attachment Theory.
centralQuestion: How does instinctual proximity-seeking between infant and caregiver establish cognitive-affective internal working models that regulate emotional security and intimacy?

keyWorks.title: Attachment and Loss, Vol. 1: Attachment
keyWorks.description: Establishes the ethological basis of instinctive human attachment behaviors and evolutionary survival value.

keyWorks.title: Attachment and Loss, Vol. 2: Separation: Anxiety and Anger
keyWorks.description: Investigates the traumatic phases of separation: protest, despair, and detachment.

keyWorks.title: Attachment and Loss, Vol. 3: Loss: Sadness and Depression
keyWorks.description: Examines pathological mourning, defensive exclusion, and internal working models of self and other.
